headline: Maximizing Monthly Credit Card Perks: A July Checklist for Amex Cardholders
reasoning: This topic offers high reader value and actionability, directly impacting how travelers can save money and utilize their existing credit card benefits. While specific to July, the recurring nature of the article makes it an evergreen strategy for maximizing points and miles. The source, The Points Guy, is a highly credible and established authority in the travel rewards space.
summary: The article provides a detailed monthly checklist for American Express cardholders to ensure they are utilizing all available 'use it or lose it' perks and statement credits for July, covering various Amex Platinum, Gold, Business, and Delta co-branded cards.

source_articles.title: Monthly checklist: Credit card perks and benefits you should be using in July
source_articles.excerpt: There are numerous monthly perks and credits you should be using on your credit cards in July 2026. We've compiled them here so you won't forget about them.
